article_title: Why Trump's new tariffs are less of a threat
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level B; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article say Trump's latest tariffs are less threatening than last April's measures?
options: They are delayed, subject to consultation and negotiation, and face legal and political constraints
They apply only to the United Kingdom
They have already been repealed by every US state
They eliminate all previous tariff rules
tasks.correct_answer: They are delayed, subject to consultation and negotiation, and face legal and political constraints
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המכסים פחות מאיימים משום שהם נדחו, כפופים להתייעצות ולמשא ומתן, ונתונים למגבלות משפטיות ופוליטיות.

tasks.prompt: When are the new tariffs expected to take effect?
options: Immediately after the announcement
January or possibly February
After the next presidential election
Only after the G20 summit in Miami
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה אומרת שהמכסים צפויים להיכנס לתוקף בינואר או אולי בפברואר.

tasks.prompt: What happened to the original emergency legal basis for the tariffs?
options: Congress extended it for ten years
China accepted it in the Trump-Xi deal
The Supreme Court struck it down
Twenty-five states adopted it
tasks.correct_answer: The Supreme Court struck it down
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בית המשפט העליון ביטל את הבסיס המשפטי המקורי של מצב החירום.

tasks.prompt: What does “upper ceilings” mean when describing the announced tariff rates?
options: Minimum rates that cannot be changed
Rates applying only to buildings
Final rates already collected
Maximum rates that may be lowered through negotiation
tasks.correct_answer: Maximum rates that may be lowered through negotiation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: upper ceilings הם שיעורי מקסימום, שעשויים לרדת במסגרת משא ומתן.

tasks.prompt: Why has US leverage over China weakened?
options: China has become more dependent on US buyers
A smaller share of Chinese exports now goes to the US
The US no longer imports Chinese products
China has accepted immediate retaliation
tasks.correct_answer: A smaller share of Chinese exports now goes to the US
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר חלק קטן יותר מהיצוא הסיני מגיע לארה״ב, לסין קל יותר להפנות סחורות לשווקים אחרים.

tasks.prompt: What could threaten tariffs on Canada authorised under Section 338?
options: A Senate repeal bill supported by Democrats and possibly rebel Republicans
A request from the UK over its digital services tax
A ruling by the G20 summit host
A new forced-labour agreement with China
tasks.correct_answer: A Senate repeal bill supported by Democrats and possibly rebel Republicans
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קיימת הצעת חוק לביטול, וייתכן שיהיו מספיק רפובליקנים מורדים כדי לאיים בעקיפת וטו נשיאותי.

tasks.prompt: How did Beijing respond to the latest tariff announcement?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שהתגובה הייתה מתונה, ללא צעדי תגמול, עם דחיית טענת עודף הייצור וקריאה ליישום הסכם שי־טראמפ.
expected_points: It called industrial overcapacity a false issue.
It urged implementation of the Xi-Trump deal.

tasks.prompt: Explain how global trade has adapted to Trump's tariff wall.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שמדינות הסיטו זרמי סחר, שהיצוא הסיני לשווקים אחרים פיצה בהרבה על הירידה הכוללת, ושקנדה הרחיבה יצוא מחוץ לארה״ב.
expected_points: Trade flows have been rerouted around the US tariff barrier.
China's increased exports to other markets more than offset its overall decline compared with 2024.
Canada's exports to the US were flat, but its commodity exports elsewhere grew sharply.
The world economy proved more resilient than expected.

tasks.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences comparing the latest tariff announcement with last April's shock.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות בין הרטוריקה וההטלה המיידית באפריל לבין ההכרזה הזהירה, ההתייעצות, המו״מ, תקרות השיעורים והבסיס המשפטי החדש.
expected_points: Last April's announcement used dramatic rhetoric and created an overnight shock.
The latest announcement was more tentative and emphasised further negotiation.
Implementation is delayed until January or February after consultation.
The announced rates are ceilings rather than necessarily final levels.
The new move also appears designed to strengthen the tariffs' legal basis.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the legal, political and economic reasons the new tariffs may have a smaller impact.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את העיכוב והמו״מ, הבסיסים המשפטיים הנתונים לערעור, הקונגרס הדמוקרטי, היחלשות המנוף מול סין והסתגלות הסחר העולמי.
expected_points: The tariffs are delayed and negotiable.
Their legal foundations face court challenges after the emergency basis was struck down.
A Democratic Congress intends to seek repeal, while some Republicans may rebel over Canada.
China sends a smaller share of exports to the US, reducing American leverage.
Other countries have already rerouted trade and adapted to the tariff wall.
